Dünyanın her yerinde insanları uzay ve a: An open-source space simulator and astrophysics classroom, built to bring people everywhere closer to space and astrophysics
Your Eyes In Space, dünyanın her yerinde: Your Eyes In Space was built to raise public awareness of space, astrophysics and astronomy and to spark interest in them all over the world. 2.8 million real stars, 6,400 exoplanets, 284,000 asteroids and comets, 44,000 real galaxies, thousands of pulsars, nebulae and clusters, black holes; a mission planner, narrated tours and interactive lessons that follow a textbook, all in a single browser tab.
Okullar, gökevleri, bilim merkezleri, bi: We're open to joint projects, translations and contributions with schools, planetariums, science centres, science communicators and researchers. An e-mail is enough.

Bilimsel kataloglar: asteroit ve kuyrukl: Scientific catalogues: asteroids and comets — NASA/JPL Small-Body Database; pulsars — ATNF Pulsar Catalogue (Manchester et al. 2005); open clusters — MWSC (Kharchenko et al. 2013); globular clusters — Harris (2010 edition); planetary nebulae — Strasbourg–ESO Catalogue (Acker et al. 1992); supernova remnants — Green (2019); H II regions — WISE Catalog of Galactic H II Regions (Anderson et al. 2014); nearby galaxies — Updated Nearby Galaxy Catalog (Karachentsev et al. 2013); galaxy survey — 2MASS Redshift Survey (Huchra et al. 2012); brown dwarfs — UltracoolSheet (Best et al. 2024); multiple stars — Multiple Star Catalogue (Tokovinin 2018) and the USNO Sixth Catalog of Orbits of Visual Binary Stars (ORB6). Catalogues accessed through NASA HEASARC and CDS VizieR.
